module.Chapter: Chapter 5 · Functions, Files, and Raspberry Pi
module.Title: Create a Sensor Function
module.Teaching: A function packages reusable instructions. def names the function, and return sends a value back to the caller.
PredictionOptions: Sends a result back to the caller
module.PredictionExplanation: return makes the function's result available to other code.
module.DebugPrompt: Add a colon to the function header and indent the return statement.
module.RecallPrompt: Create read_temperature from memory. Use the exact value 21.5.
module.PreviewMessage: The facility now has a reusable sensor-reading function.
